title: Escape or a click outside does not close the window
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You are filling in a new term and press Escape or click outside the window by mistake.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A name, {Term-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-22 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click on the page outside the window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: the window stays open, with {Term-A} and 14 still typed.
  • Step 5: the window stays open, with everything still typed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R15: “Pressing Escape or clicking outside the window does not close it, and keeps everything typed.”
  • Key Decisions: “Departure: the New Credit Term and Move Customers windows do not close on Escape or a click outside.”
